basic_details.short_information: National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU), Gandhinagar, an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, needs one Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) for the Information Security Education and Awareness (ISEA) Project Phase III. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, funds the project. The post is purely contractual, initially for 11 months, and pays Rs.42,000/- per month (consolidated). qualification.details: Master's Degree with Computer Science/IT/Cyber Security/Cyber Forensics / Digital Forensics or equivalent with minimum 60% or First Class.

how_to_apply: The application is accepted only through email; no other mode is described in the notice. The deadline for submission of the application is 13 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Prepare your full profile with the list of research articles.
Make sure the application gives a valid e-mail ID.
Write "Application for the post of Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics)" in the subject line of the email.
Send the email to [email protected] before 13 November 2026, 11:59 PM.
Full profile with the list of research articles (sent with the email application).
Latest CV (to be presented at the interview).
Copy of research articles, if any (at the interview).
Original mark sheets/certificates in support of academic qualifications (at the interview).
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer, for applicants in employment (private, government or any other organization), at the time of interview.
important_instructions: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and photographs submitted. rows.details: National Forensic Sciences University (An Institution of National Importance under Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India)
Information Security Education and Awareness (ISEA) Project Phase - III
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India
Initially 11 Months (extendible commensurate upon performance and evaluation after 11 months)
35 Years as on the Last Date of Receiving Application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's Degree with Computer Science/IT/Cyber Security/Cyber Forensics / Digital Forensics or equivalent with minimum 60% or First Class. Desired: JRF with Good Communication and project management Skills. Candidates with the Knowledge and Experience of Cyber forensics will be preferred. The age limit is 35 Years as on the Last Date of Receiving Application, which is 13 November 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) receives Rs.42,000/- per month (consolidated). The post is purely on a contractual basis. The engagement is initially for 11 months and is extendible commensurate upon performance and evaluation after 11 months. The notice does not mention HRA or any other allowance on top of the consolidated amount.

content_sections.heading: NFSU Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) Job Description
content_sections.text: To undertake research and other tasks as per the requirement of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NFSU Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics)
content_sections.text: The application is accepted only through email; no other mode is described in the notice. The deadline for submission of the application is 13 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Prepare your full profile with the list of research articles. Make sure the application gives a valid e-mail ID. Write "Application for the post of Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics)" in the subject line of the email. Send the email to [email protected] before 13 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Full profile with the list of research articles (sent with the email application). Latest CV (to be presented at the interview). Copy of research articles, if any (at the interview). Original mark sheets/certificates in support of academic qualifications (at the interview). No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer, for applicants in employment (private, government or any other organization), at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates have to present themselves for the interview on the interview date. The candidates will be selected on the basis of merit and need of the project. The interview date is not specified in the notice. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and photographs submitted. Mere possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure that the candidate would be selected. Applicants in employment must bring an NOC from their employer at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NFSU Recruitment 2026 for Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics)?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) post under the ISEA Phase III Project at NFSU, Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NFSU Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) post?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications is 13 November 2026, and the email must be sent by 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NFSU Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) post?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree with Computer Science/IT/Cyber Security/Cyber Forensics / Digital Forensics or equivalent with minimum 60% or First Class is essential. JRF with good communication and project management skills is desired, and knowledge and experience of cyber forensics will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NFSU Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 Years as on the Last Date of Receiving Application, which is 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NFSU Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics)?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.42,000/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NFSU Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) post?
faq.answer: Send your full profile with the list of research articles only by email to [email protected] by 13 November 2026, 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: The subject line must read "Application for the post of Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics)".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the NFSU Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and candidates will be selected on the basis of merit and need of the project.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NFSU Research Assistant (Cyber Forensics) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely on a contractual basis, initially for 11 months, extendible commensurate upon performance and evaluation after 11 months.

faq.question: Q10. Will NFSU pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
